correctness.rationale: The complement of a minimum blue zero-forcing set chooses at most one vertex per peripheral clique and has size r, omitting one of r+1 parts; the hub-white/all-parts-white obstruction is correctly treated. One-for-one exchanges give A full transversals and B_i omitted peripheral representatives. Tensor splitting of each size-m coordinate into constants and mean-zero modes gives, in harmonic support T, the (r-|T|+1)-dimensional matrix with 2x2 quotient quadratic and (r-|T|-1) equal eigenvalues; products yield every factor, gap and matrix-tree count. Boundary t=0 and t=r sectors, r>=3,m>=2 checked. Independently built exchange graphs for (3,2),(3,3),(4,2); 20,54,48-dimensional numerical Laplacian spectra matched the exact predicted complete eigenvalue multisets with max errors <2e-14, and the gap matched. Infinite factorization is analytic.
